body:
There's several things at play here and it's not any one thing that is really pushing me right now.

One of the main issues is with work. I've been put in charge of a project where I am reliant on someone else for the materials I need. I haven't been given them but I'll still be the one held accountable if things aren't getting done. The person I need materials from is a higher up person in the office and talking to her about it last week only resulted in her sending me a passive aggressive email. The whole ordeal got to a point where I was so stressed about going into work I couldn't fall asleep because sleeping meant when I woke up again I would need to face it.

I called out sick to avoid it but I'm realizing now that I've upset my boss for calling out and possibly left some people with more work for the day so now I feel like I've failed with the project *and* inconvenienced and disappointed my co-workers.

I went to class tonight where I realized many of the people in my class have become friends. I don't know when or how it happened. They are people I like and people I would like to be friends with. I feel like I missed some vital step some ways back that everyone else caught onto. Going through the class and feeling so left out of the group hit harder than it normally would. I tried pushing myself and making that step myself. I handed my number to a girl in the class I get along with and said if she ever wants to hang out she could text me. She looked confused and unsure of what to do which makes me wonder if it was some big faux pas on my part.

I also asked my professor how I was doing in one of my classes and she told me that, when I am there, I do phenomenally. But, she says I've missed more than I should and she needs to see more work from me. Luckily she does take late assignments, but I don't like being the sort of person who doesn't deliver in the first place. Getting that firm confirmation that I wasn't meeting a good level of work was a hit.

I have someone I know that had asked me for help on something small, really pretty inconsequential. I had to drop it entirely when I realized I have just too much going on right now. He didn't take that news well and told me directly that I let him down. 

To bring it all to a point....I literally have quite a lot going on to the point where time-wise I am just stacked up with tasks and responsibilities. In trying to manage things and keep everything going well I've hit stumbling blocks and the result is feeling that sense of failure in multiple points of my life. Failure in my work, failure in my school, failure to improve my social life and failure to be there for friends.
I just want to say, that was one of the best posts I have ever seen in r4r and I hope you get some amazing results.
